verdict.rationale: Brex's marketing documents configurable multi-level approval flows routed automatically by amount, vendor and employee role (Bill Pay), and expense policies that define who must approve. The review agent's "escalates exceptions" refers to policy exceptions, not to approvers sitting on requests. Missing for 10: explicit manager → budget-owner → finance chain configuration for expenses/requests, approver delegation, time-based escalation or reminders for stalled approvals, in-depth docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
